# tag in scheme

Relates a tag to a scheme it belongs to. Non-functional: a tag may reside in many schemes (cross-listing).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tagInScheme>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:tagInScheme`  

*object property* · domain `gmeow:Tag` · range `gmeow:TagScheme`
